mainEntity.name: What should I do when multiple AI assistants duplicate work or contradict each other?

acceptedAnswer.text: If two assistants produce overlapping work, assign each a distinct responsibility and define the system of record. For example, research collects evidence, an offer assistant turns approved findings into positioning, and a content assistant drafts customer-facing material. Do not let all three independently rewrite the same facts. Key controls include one owner per deliverable, version labels, input requirements, and a final reviewer. Measure duplicate effort and correction time to determine whether a specialist is useful or should be removed. Run My AI Biz’s resource library contains many specialized examples, so selective adoption is better than activating every available bot.
acceptedAnswer.description: Give each assistant one defined responsibility and designate a system of record for facts and decisions. Use version labels, explicit inputs, one deliverable owner, and a final reviewer. Remove assistants that add duplicate work without improving quality or speed.
